summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing that 62.5 MWh of battery energy storage is fully operational across three Spanish industrial sites—ECO Porcelanico, Compacglass and TAU Porcelanico—under its previously disclosed $53 million contract to supply and implement 366 MWh across 10 factories. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. The update is an ordinary operational milestone, incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf. What to watch: execution progress on remaining delivered capacity, but no risk-arb angle.
